Affix.Name: Epochal Advent
Affix.Desc: The equipping character gains 1 Starspark when they use an Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst, or perform a Normal Attack. Up to 2 Starsparks can be held at once. The equipping character gains Undying Radiance while holding at least 1 Starspark. This effect increases the CRIT Rate of their Cryo DMG by 20%, with an additional 20% CRIT Rate if that DMG is Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. The equipping character loses 1 Starspark every 3s while on the field. Undying Radiance ends when all Starsparks are extinguished.

EQUIP_RING.Name: Goblet of the Epochal Advent
EQUIP_RING.Desc: The high heavens bestowed sweet nectar on their envoy, and the unending feast opened wide the doors to desire.

EQUIP_NECKLACE.Name: Plume of the Epochal Advent
EQUIP_NECKLACE.Desc: The high heavens bestowed a feather of rebirth on their envoy, with all sin to be forgiven where even fate meets its very end.

EQUIP_DRESS.Name: Circlet of the Epochal Advent
EQUIP_DRESS.Desc: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.

EQUIP_BRACER.Name: Flower of the Epochal Advent
EQUIP_BRACER.Desc: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.

EQUIP_SHOES.Name: Sands of the Epochal Advent
EQUIP_SHOES.Desc: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.
